items.q: calling myself a bandleader... I have a picture of that, with Woody Herman.

ctx.x: Well, I would consider that was about the last year that I travelled anywhere, calling myself a bandleader. Of course, along about that time, I might have gone a little longer, but we were considered--and I have a picture of that, with Woody Herman.
